name: Blaxploitation Cinema
description: The blaxploitation film movement of the 1970s: the directors, actors, and funk/soul composers who defined a wave of Black-led American genre cinema, and the studios that distributed it. Spans the movement's ignition (Cotton Comes to Harlem, Sweet Sweetback's Baadasssss Song, Shaft) through its commercial peak and decline, including the era-defining soundtracks that outlasted the films.
author: HistoryNet Contributors

subgroups.name: Composers & Musicians
subgroups.description: Funk/soul artists who scored the films

scope.exclusionNotes: Focus on the 1970s-early-80s US blaxploitation wave. Excludes later homages/parodies (e.g. 1988's I'm Gonna Git You Sucka, 1990s+ throwbacks) except as influence links.
